title: Engineering Disclaimer & Legal Terms

sections.heading: Engineering Reference Only — Provided AS-IS Without Warranty
paragraphs: All pinout diagrams, electrical specifications, cross-reference compatibility classifications, calculator outputs, and technical guides published on Pin2Pin Global (pin2pin.dev) are provided strictly for preliminary engineering reference on an "AS-IS" and "AS-AVAILABLE" basis without warranties of any kind, either express or implied, including but not limited to implied warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, accuracy, completeness, or non-infringement.

Semiconductor manufacturers periodically publish datasheet revisions, errata, Product Change Notifications (PCNs), and End-of-Life (EOL) notices without prior notice to third-party reference databases. Pin2Pin Global, its maintainers, and its contributors assume zero liability for any direct, indirect, incidental, consequential, or special damages — including damaged prototypes, PCB re-spins, manufacturing scrap, field failures, lost revenue, or personal injury — arising out of or in connection with the use of, or reliance upon, any information or calculation on this site.

sections.heading: Mandatory Safety-Critical Systems Exclusion
paragraphs: Information, compatibility classifications, and engineering calculations on Pin2Pin Global are NOT approved, certified, or authorized for use in safety-critical, high-reliability, or life-dependent applications where component failure could result in personal injury, death, or severe environmental or property damage.
bullets: Medical & Life-Support Systems: Strictly excluded from IEC 60601 medical electrical equipment, implantable devices, patient-monitoring instruments, or life-support apparatus.
Automotive & Transportation Safety: Strictly excluded from AEC-Q100 / ISO 26262 automotive safety-integrity-level (ASIL) systems, powertrain, braking, airbag, or ADAS electronics.
Aerospace, Defense & Nuclear: Strictly excluded from DO-254 avionics, spacecraft, flight-control, nuclear facility instrumentation, or weapons systems.

Qualified Engineering Sign-Off Required: Any deployment in regulated or mission-critical hardware requires independent qualification directly with the semiconductor manufacturer using current official controlled documentation.

sections.heading: Obligation to Verify Official Manufacturer Datasheets
paragraphs: Even where Pin2Pin Global assigns a "Level 1: Candidate Drop-In (Verify Datasheet Before Production)" classification, that label indicates only that verified datasheet parameters meet our screening criteria as a candidate for engineering evaluation — it is never an absolute drop-in guarantee.

Before committing to PCB layout, schematic release, component substitution, or volume assembly, a qualified hardware engineer must independently verify pinout numbering, Top/Bottom view orientation, exposed thermal pad net connectivity, capacitor ESR stability margins, transient voltage ratings, thermal junction temperature rise (Tj), and part-marking codes against the latest official manufacturer datasheet and physical prototype bench testing.

paragraphs: All semiconductor manufacturer names, brand names, series identifiers, and Orderable Part Numbers (OPNs) referenced on Pin2Pin Global — including Texas Instruments, Diodes Incorporated, onsemi, Advanced Monolithic Systems, and others — are the trademarks or registered trademarks of their respective owners. Their use on this site is strictly for nominative engineering identification and factual cross-reference comparison; Pin2Pin Global is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any semiconductor manufacturer.

Pin2Pin Global does not copy, mirror, or redistribute manufacturer PDF datasheets or proprietary manufacturer logos. All SVG pinout diagrams and structured parameter tables are independently generated from factual electrical and mechanical specifications, with outbound links directing users to the official manufacturer websites.

sections.heading: Zero-Scraping Distributor Links & Affiliate Disclosure
paragraphs: Outbound distributor buttons (DigiKey, Mouser, LCSC) are standard search-query deeplinks that open the distributor's public search page for the selected OPN. Pin2Pin Global does not scrape distributor websites or permanently cache distributor pricing or inventory data.

Affiliate relationships never influence technical specifications, compatibility tiers, or component rankings.
